brief:
Israeli government ministers are orchestrating illegal settlement announcements as campaign activities ahead of the October 27 election, Al Jazeera English reported. The tactic reflects competition among politicians to project strength ahead of the vote, with settlement expansion serving as a platform for electoral messaging.

Ministers have tied West Bank settlement policy directly to their campaigns, using announcements of new construction in occupied Palestinian territory to appeal to voters during the election period.
dek: With Israelis voting on October 27, ministers are staging illegal settlement launches as campaign events.
title: Israeli ministers stage settlement launches as election campaign events
